page.layout: One printed page, single column of text with two parallel columns of verb forms (Latin left, Latin right) in each conjugation block; running head at top; page number at top left; a catchword-like signature "Fu." at lower right is a line of text, not a catchword.
page.notes: The Greek-looking and Spanish-like forms (Andáua, Andáʃti) are printed in italic with long s rendered as ʃ in the scan; the italic Greek-letter-like glyphs are copied as printed. Right-hand column lines are the Latin translations. The tail "Fu." at lower right is a printed word fragment (likely "Fuit" or a catchword-style marker); its reading is uncertain. Right margin shows show-through from the reverse page, not transcribed.
